description: Phase 3: race definitions, race session lifecycle (lobby, bot fill to >=12, countdown, checkpoints/laps, results, rewards), bot drivers and car-vs-car OBB collisions, test oval. Depends on FEAT-002.
steps: Read .agents/inbox.md, then implement plan.md items 3.1-3.4 in order exactly as written in /projects/sandbox/Forzacraft/.agents/tasks/forzacraft/plan.md (files, behaviour, verification per item).
After each completed item: run its Verify command, then git add the specific files, commit (conventional message) and git push origin main.
Any point needing a user decision: append a question to .agents/questions.md, send_message severity 'info', mark the item DEFERRED (Qn) in plan.md, continue with other items.

Finish with the Phase 3 DONE CHECK: bash tools/ci/done-check.sh (and COMPAT=server bash tools/ci/server-smoke.sh where the plan says so); record command outputs summary, test counts, screenshot paths in findings.
acceptance_criteria: GameTest: 1 player + 11 bots race ends with ordered results and reward credited
GameTest: 12 bots finish 2 laps, none stuck >10 s
